project: Environmental Data Cube for Oglala Lakota
assessment: Integrated Landsat NDMI and NDVI vegetation trajectory assessment

climate_context.note: Climate values provide regional context and are not parcel-wide gridded observations.

limitations: Vegetation indices do not directly measure grazing pressure.
NDMI and NDVI share Landsat spectral information.
Some boundary-intersecting cells are excluded by the mask.
Field and management data are needed for sustainability conclusions.
data_governance: Respect Oglala Lakota Nation data governance and applicable permissions before sharing parcel-level spatial products.
